$comment: The stable operations of apps/docs-site/public/openapi.json that have no wire test yet, each with why and the issue that ends the exemption (#535, ADR-018 §5). This list may only shrink: CI fails a pull request that adds an entry, and an entry whose operation gains a passing wire test, leaves the document or turns experimental must be removed. Experimental operations never appear here; their stability exempts them. See apps/wire-suite/README.md and the "How the wire suite grows" section of CONTRIBUTING.md.

exemptions.reason: The Interaction API document. The Interaction API epic brings the API's wire tests; none reads the document yet.
A greeting that carries no contract a client relies on. No area issue owns its wire test, so it stays with the wire conformance epic.
